GSS CUMULATIVE DATA FILE 1972-2024, RELEASE 3: VARIABLE CODEBOOK
Plain text rendering of the variable documentation distributed in the gssrdoc R package (kjhealy/gssrdoc on GitHub),
which the package author generated from NORC's GSS Data Explorer variable pages. One block per variable. Values
are the numeric codes used in the data file with their labels. Missing responses of every kind (don't know, no
answer, not applicable because the question was not asked of the respondent, skipped on web, not available in
the year) are stored as empty values in the data file. The counts by year are counts of records in the data file,
not weighted estimates. Rendered 2026-10-07 by the task author with a conversion script; no text was added or
removed beyond the markup.
